notes:
POC summary (trial on Hosted API):
- Duration: 6 weeks, integrated into staging via SDK; traffic replay using last 30 days of anonymized events.
- Observed steady-state QPS: ~12 QPS; peak observed burst: 48 QPS (10 min window).
- Token mix (measured): 70% short completions (~50 tokens), 20% medium (~250 tokens), 10% long/in-context generations (~1200 tokens).
- Weighted avg tokens per request during POC: ~205 tokens.
- Avg request latency (hosted): p50 90ms (short), p95 260ms (short); medium p95 ~420ms; long p95 ~1.2s.
- Key asks from product team: P95 latency <250ms for short completions; graceful fallback to quantized models under capacity; deterministic routing by region and customer tier.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; wants to push heavy reranking to smaller models and only route large-context chat to higher-cost workers.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logging sent to customer SIEM, KMS support (customer-managed key/HSM), EU residency for EU customer traffic.
- Quote request: Dedicated baseline for production expected to cover steady 55 QPS with ability to burst to 220 QPS for promotional spikes. Team requested cost estimate for 3 sizing options (baseline, baseline+burst, baseline+50% buffer).
- Technical notes: currently using prefix caching for doc-search but plan to adopt KV caching for long-context chat. SE recommended 2x A100-equivalent workers (quantized) + 1x higher-memory GPU for long runs, with autoscale policy to add additional workers at 150 QPS sustained for 5 minutes.
- "We see most cost coming from long context calls during onboarding flows" — product lead.
- Next: compute final Dedicated quote, produce migration runbook (routing + feature flags), schedule KMS integration walkthrough.
traffic_forecast: Current (trial): steady 12 QPS, peak 48 QPS, avg tokens/request ~205
30d post-launch (expected): steady 35 QPS, peak 120 QPS, increase due to org-wide rollout
6 months: steady 55 QPS, peak 220 QPS (marketing campaigns + new customers), concurrency target 40-60 depending on model mix
Token mix forecast: short 60%, medium 25%, long 15% (long-tail grows with feature adoption)
Concurrency planning: plan for 60 concurrent generation contexts; recommend keeping 10 warm workers to hold KV/prefix caches
capacity_sizing_notes: SE calc (rough): baseline steady 55 QPS * 205 tokens = ~11.3k tokens/s (~40.6M tokens/hr)
GPU sizing guidance: quantized 13B instances for short/medium; reserve 1-2 high-memory instances for long-context (>= 24GB)
Batching and cache: enable continuous batching with 10-50ms batch window for cost efficiency; prefix/KV cache to reduce repeated context cost
Routing: set policy to route low-latency churn to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted API tier during unplanned capacity events
SLA asks: 99.9% uptime; p95 latency targets as above; incident notification via PagerDuty
deployment_notes: Customer prefers Dedicated in us-east for primary traffic, but must ensure EU residency for EU customers. Wants private VPC peering and ability to rotate keys monthly. On-prem not required at this stage.
